title: Microsoft SharePoint and Work IQ Gatekeepers
goal: Add production-oriented, resource-confined SharePoint support to the existing delegated Graph Gatekeeper, then design and optionally build a separate Work IQ Gatekeeper after SharePoint is verified.

decisions.summary: Keep Microsoft Graph and Work IQ in separate packages with separate OAuth accounts, token audiences, callbacks, and deployment controls.
Use delegated Sites.Selected with tenant-admin-provisioned read or write assignments on explicitly approved sites.
Bind SharePoint resources by immutable siteId, driveId, and itemId rather than mutable SharePoint paths.
Deliver document/folder capability with observer strategy B before site-wide capability with strategy C.
Ship and verify read-only SharePoint access before separately approving writes.
Fail closed on ambiguous Graph errors and Work IQ tool/schema drift.

tasks.title: Confirm authority and tenant operations
tasks.acceptance: Authority-before/after table, selected-site assignment process, file-size limits, and named approver are documented without credentials.
tasks.verification: Approved 2026-09-01 and updated 2026-09-02: digital-utilities site, whole-site read role, separate Global Administrator operation, exact URL selection, files/folders only, raw bytes, 50 MB streamed, 5 MB buffered, uploads disabled, shared Gadgets fail closed unless observer checks pass.

evidence.provisioning: Separate tenant Global Administrator operation; no runtime grant-management authority
evidence.sharedGadgets: allowed only after observer-owned delegated access verification

tasks.title: Harden existing Graph OAuth
tasks.acceptance: Tests prove PKCE, OAuth replay/expiry rejection, incremental consent, refresh-token rotation, and existing Outlook behavior.
tasks.verification: Completed 2026-09-01: RFC 7636 challenge, token-exchange verifier, and refresh rotation tests pass; verifier uses existing expiring one-time OAuth state; package tests, tsc --noEmit, and full pnpm check pass.

evidence.test: pnpm --dir packages/gatekeeper-microsoft exec vitest run src/microsoft-oauth.test.ts
evidence.packageValidation: rm -rf .wrangler/validate && pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm types:check

tasks.title: Propose and approve SharePoint capability interfaces
tasks.acceptance: Operator explicitly approves agent-facing interfaces, canonical resource URLs, granularities, observation/action classification, and JSDoc.
tasks.verification: Approved 2026-09-01: read-only SharePointDocumentSession; immutable file/folder binding; metadata, folder children/search, bounded raw-byte reads; strategy B; no writes; site capability deferred to strategy-C review.

tasks.title: Add SharePoint resource and scopes model
tasks.acceptance: SharePoint requests delegated Sites.Selected only for SharePoint resources; URL parsing and existing Outlook scopes are covered by tests.
tasks.verification: Completed 2026-09-01: 19 package tests and tsc --noEmit pass; canonical immutable IDs reject mutable URLs, foreign origins, malformed paths, query strings, and encoded path confusion.

tasks.title: Implement SharePoint Graph adapter
tasks.acceptance: Typed adapter confines calls to bound IDs and handles metadata, libraries, paging, search, bounded content, auth retry, throttling, safe redirects, and redacted errors.
tasks.verification: Completed 2026-09-01: package tests and tsc --noEmit pass; assigned-site URL resolution and returned URLs are confined; library discovery avoids tenant search; paging/search cursors are bound; byte reads are capped; bearer tokens do not reach download hosts; denial/throttling/malformed responses are covered.

tasks.title: Ship read-only document and folder Gatekeeper
tasks.acceptance: Document/folder reads are resource-confined, observation-authorized, strategy-B verified with observer-owned tokens, and selectable through a narrow configurator.
tasks.verification: Completed 2026-09-01: Node and workerd suites prove canonical dispatch/rejection, authorization-before-return including empty pages, file/folder mismatches, read-only actions, strategy-B observer outcomes, verifier fail-closed classification, and configurator resolution/prefill/edit behavior; full pnpm check passes.

evidence.observer: MicrosoftVerifier.hasSharePointItemAccess with fail-closed transient error handling
evidence.configurator: Exact assigned-site URL resolution to canonical immutable resource URL
evidence.currentValidation: 36 Node tests, 25 workerd tests, package tsc, and full pnpm check pass

tasks.title: Evaluate and verify document support
tasks.acceptance: Evaluation proves selected assignment, positive/negative users and observers, unassigned-site denial, content bounds, Outlook regressions, Access, and private routes.
tasks.verification: Deployed by approved production continuations 2026-09-02. Authenticated testing against only os-test now proves folder listing, recursive open(itemId), metadata, and child file content reads. The remaining negative-user, observer, Outlook regression, and private-route matrix is still pending.

evidence.liveFinding: Folder listing, recursive child open, metadata, and hello.txt content read succeed
evidence.deployedFix: Recursive open(itemId), immutable ancestry confinement, strategy-C item tracking, and Workers-compatible manual download redirects

tasks.title: Add site and library capability with strategy C
tasks.acceptance: Site-wide observations track every revealed item data set and correctly reverify/exclude observers under concurrency and ACL variation.
tasks.verification: Observer admission-race, multi-item page, revoked-access, rename, delete, retry, and excludeObservers tests.

tasks.title: Add approved SharePoint writes
tasks.acceptance: Approved create/upload/replace/rename/same-site-move intents cannot execute before applyAction and remain site-confined; delete and sharing stay unavailable.
tasks.verification: Submit-without-side-effect, apply, reject, stale-eTag, confinement, upload recovery, idempotency, and approval-description tests.

tasks.title: Production deployment and closeout
tasks.acceptance: Approved production subset is deployed once, fully live-verified, versioned, documented, and paired with current rollback/revocation evidence.
tasks.verification: Fresh pnpm check, production mutation summary, version inventory, full live operator checklist, and DEPLOYMENT.md update.

tasks.title: Prove Work IQ tenant feasibility
tasks.acceptance: Sanitized report proves licensing, availability, permissions, callback flow, MCP schemas/errors, governance, privacy, and observer-oracle feasibility or records a stop decision.
tasks.verification: Tenant/admin inspection and isolated protocol evaluation against Microsoft primary documentation.

tasks.title: Approve Work IQ interfaces and package design
tasks.acceptance: Operator approves document capability, authority matrix, observer strategy, OAuth separation, McpClient and ToolCatalog seams, and disabled deployment posture.

tasks.title: Build and test MCP transport without real credentials
tasks.acceptance: McpClient handles initialization, Streamable HTTP, SSE, sessions, bounds, redirects, timeouts, IDs, retries, and redaction against fakes.
tasks.verification: Deterministic MCP transport contract tests using sanitized fixtures.

tasks.title: Implement separate Work IQ OAuth and account state
tasks.acceptance: PKCE/resource-audience OAuth is tenant/server-pinned, rotation-safe, separately stored, and impossible to confuse with Graph credentials/accounts.
tasks.verification: OAuth metadata, callback, replay, rotation, redirect-origin, token-separation, and redaction tests.

tasks.title: Add schema-gated read-only document scenarios
tasks.acceptance: Only locally approved SharePoint/Word scenarios are exposed; schema drift fails closed; document reads are selected-resource confined and observation-authorized.
tasks.verification: Tool catalog fixtures, drift/unknown-tool tests, configurator round-trip, observation tests, and isolated live reads.

tasks.title: Add optional deployment integration
tasks.acceptance: Disabled configuration produces no Worker/bindings; enabled configuration produces one private Worker at the exact callback path and correct deployment order.
tasks.verification: Deployment-config tests and full pnpm check in disabled and enabled variants.

tasks.title: Evaluate Work IQ and decide whether to continue
tasks.acceptance: Written go/no-go decision compares Work IQ with direct Graph using live evidence for authority, reliability, privacy, governance, latency, and schema stability.
tasks.verification: Isolated evaluation deployment and documented decision.

tasks.title: Optionally add approved Work IQ writes
tasks.acceptance: Only approved document creation/comment scenarios use typed pending actions and apply-time schema validation; destructive/expansive tools remain unavailable.
tasks.verification: Approval, rejection, idempotency, schema-drift, and no-immediate-side-effect tests.
